messages:
maria: Heads-up — assembling release notes for 2.7.1. Need final PR list, pin matrix, and canary window. Target deploy 2026-03-24 23:00 UTC. +cc @oncall-liz

sam: I'll finish the changelog bullets by EOD. Can you paste the PRs you want highlighted?

kevin: pushed perf fix PR #3245. Recommend we include as 'perf: reduce KV cache thrash on long seqs' :thumbsup:

maria: Added PRs: #3245 (perf), #3238 (docs), #3251 (rollback guard). Draft notes below — please eyeball.

maria: ```
Release 2.7.1 (internal)
- Serving runtime: kernel selection prefers fused-attention for xformers-compatible models (est. -7% token latency)
- Batching: transient batch cutoff to avoid tail latency spikes
- Safety: rollback guard to clear stale model pins after failed canary
- Ops: new deploy flag `--pin-model=redwood-open-7b-v2-q4` for canary
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window set: 2026-03-24T23:00Z → prod-blue. Canary 5% for 15m, then 50% for 30m. Rollback triggers: error rate >3% or p95 latency >800ms.

julie: For internal announce, propose two bullets: what changed + action for engineers (check pins). I'll draft a short blurb.

sam: One ask — confirm fallback pin includes previous stable `redwood-open-7b-v1` so services with pinned overrides don't blow up. Kevin?

kevin: Confirmed: v1 compatible as fallback; also note quantized variant `redwood-open-7b-v1-q4` available.

oncall-liz: I'll be oncall for the window. If deploy-bot flips to rollback, ping #eng-oncall and I'll execute rollback playbook. Please set PD escalation to oncall-liz.

maria: Updated RN in /docs/internal/rn-2.7.1.md (internal). Julie — can you convert this into the internal announcement copy? I'll attach the pin matrix and PRs.

julie: Draft internal announcement: "Deploying 2.7.1 tonight 23:00 UTC — low-risk perf and safety fixes. Canary 5% for 15m → 50% for 30m. Action: If your service pins models, verify compatibility or update to pinned fallback by 20:00 UTC. Link: <internal doc>"

sam: LGTM. Add: "Rollback plan: ops will revert to `redwood-open-7b-v1` on triggered rollback. Unless you have custom pins, no action required."

deploy-bot: To schedule via CLI: `/deploy release 2.7.1 --canary 5% --canary-duration 15m --pin redwood-open-7b-v2-q4`

maria: I'll run the schedule command in ~10m to validate the deploy job. Will post final announce snippet here when done.

deploy-bot: Deploy job created (job id d-20260324-2310). ETA job trigger 2026-03-24T23:00Z.

sam: Thanks — Julie will post internal announce at 21:30 UTC. @oncall-liz please watch the canary and escalate if thresholds hit.

maria: final note: include the quick rollback steps in the announcement (short link to runbook) and the pinned fallback list. I'll attach a one-line table in the RN.
file_review_notes: Thread is focused on release notes drafting, pin matrix, deploy bot scheduling, rollback thresholds, and internal announcement coordination. Short messages, a code block for RN, explicit deploy-bot responses, oncall confirmation.
